intro: The best way to get to know a band is to watch them perform live, and that’s exactly what you get here. Our videos were recorded LIVE – no dubbing, no autotune, which is almost unheard of in most promotional videos. These performances exemplify the high energy and atmosphere we’ll bring to your event. Plus, there’s the added oomph that live music provides. Without further ado, let the music play!
